caption: Marina Grande, Sorrento
composition: Cliffside harbor toward the Bay of Naples · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From above the harbor, the camera takes in Marina Grande with Sorrento's pastel houses climbing the cliff on the left and the small boat harbor curving below at center. Fishing boats lie moored along the stone quay in the soft light of the 07:14 morning, while the calm sea stretches right toward the hazy blue silhouette of Vesuvius on the horizon. The pink and ochre facades catch the first gentle daylight above the shadowed rock face.
alt_text: AI-generated artistic interpretation of Sorrento Marina Grande at clear dawn
